reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: DNS resolution occurs at line 44 (resolveHost/host), but the actual HTTP fetch happens at line 47 (openUrlByHostname) using the original user-supplied host string. This creates a DNS rebinding window where the hostname could resolve to a different IP between validation and fetch. Also, isNonPublicAddress only checks the first resolved InetAddress, leaving other IPs unresolved/unchecked.

evidence.note: User param flows to host var, DNS resolved at L44, but fetch at L47 uses original host string
